lede: The most consequential meeting this week is Tuesday's Town Council work session, which takes up the Comprehensive Plan, a Gondola Subcommittee update, and — most notably — proposals for a third-party audit of the Town's rental housing policies, a question that cuts right to the heart of who gets to stay here. Ouray County's Planning Commission also meets virtually Wednesday to work through possible changes to their Land Use Code definitions, the kind of quiet process that shapes everything downstream.

notable.stake: Third-party rental housing policy audit and Comprehensive Plan goals up for review.
Land Use Code definition changes being shaped before any public hearing.
